grid = [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in rows_text.splitlines()]
out = [row[:] for row in grid]
for c in (5,8,11):
    marks = [(r, grid[r][c]) for r in range(17) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    # each anchor colors from its row through the row before next anchor; bottom marker included
    for i,(r,color) in enumerate(marks):
        end = marks[i+1][0] if i+1 < len(marks) else 17
